title: Summer Engine or OpenCode Go + Godot?
author: LiveCourage334
selftext:
I have a project going right now where I’m kind of bouncing between these tools. I started it in Summer but felt like I was struggling to have agency in the process so I tried out OpenCode running headless Godot. 

I prefer the agency of OpenCode, but the asset generation in Summer definitely excels in prototype visuals at the expense of typical over enthusiastic AI (system suggests something and just keeps trying to plow forward with it).

Curious who uses either/both workflows, if you have one you prefer, and why?

I’m kind of leaning OpenCode because it forces me to get my hands dirty more, but I have no clue how well either system scales with larger projects.
